chapter_level: The whole chapter is nineteenth-century દલપતરામ Gujarati and the printed blue intro box orders the teaching to point at it: 'એમાં આવતા ગુજરાતી ભાષાના જૂના શબ્દો તરફ વિદ્યાર્થીઓનું ખાસ ધ્યાન દોરવું.' At std 7 an L2 reader treats these forms as spelling mistakes and stops reading for sense. Every archaic or elided form present in a topic's original_chunk — ત્યહાં, તહાં, આંહીં, જ્યાંહીં, ક્યાંહીં, વસીજે, સધ, તણો, નીસર્યા, છાંડો, દિશ, ઝાઝા, રાતેમાતે, પુરી, ભૂપ, નૃપ — is quoted in its printed form, glossed at the point of use in 'શબ્દ — અર્થ' form, and named as જૂની ગુજરાતી rather than corrected (profile avoid 11).

The king is named five different ways across the chapter — રાજા (first કડી), નૃપ, પુરપતિ, ભૂપ, અધિપતિ — and the printed શબ્દાર્થ box glosses only 'નૃપ — રાજા, અધિપતિ, ભૂપ', leaving પુરપતિ unglossed. An L2 child reads them as five different characters and the blame chain stops making sense. Wherever one of these names first appears in a topic, that topic says in plain Gujarati that it is the same રાજા.

Sensitivity, chapter-wide (profile avoid 13). The blame chain runs વણિક → કડિયો → ગારો કરનાર → પખાલી → મુલ્લા. Four of these are occupations and one is a religious title; not one of them is the poem's target and not one of them is guilty. No teaching field anywhere in the plan attaches a trait to any of these trades or to any community, and where the satire's target is named it is the નગરીનો આપખુદ, વિવેક વગરનો ન્યાય. The reflex failure to watch for in a Gujarati pack is the વેપારી stereotype at the head of the chain.

Register, chapter-wide. The engine of the poem is an execution device and the printed શબ્દાર્થ box defines શૂળી in full, so the dark-comic tone is the book's own and is neither softened away nor dwelt on. The child may laugh; no explanation, summary or recall answer turns the શૂળી into a gruesome description or into a lesson about punishment.

Std 7 attaches no craft labels (profile avoid 6, and the std-7 genre gate). The line length changes mid-poem and the book prints no છંદ name, so no છંદ and no અલંકાર may be named anywhere in the plan and figures_of_speech stays []. પ્રાસ may be heard and said aloud — the chapter's own rhyme-hunt block makes the rhyme the lesson's material — in at most one sentence per topic, placed after the event is clear.

Two lines are printed differently in the poem and in the exercises, and neither place is corrected: the verse prints 'નહીં યોગ્ય આંહીં રહ્યો રાતવાસો.' while the ભાવાર્થ block prints 'રહ્યે'; the verse prints 'મારી ચૂક ન લેશ.' while the ઘટનાક્રમ block prints 'ના લેશ'. Teaching fields quote the verse's form; exercise_solutions.json answers from the exercise's printed form.
